defmodule RateLimiter do
  use GenServer

  defstruct [:max_requests, :window_ms, :requests, :retry_queue]

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    max_req = Keyword.get(opts, :max_requests, 100)
    window = Keyword.get(opts, :window_ms, 60_000)
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %__MODULE__{
      max_requests: max_req,
      window_ms: window,
      requests: [],
      retry_queue: :queue.new()
    }, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(state), do: {:ok, state}

  def handle_call({:check_rate, _client_id}, _from, state) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    active = Enum.filter(state.requests, fn t -> now - t < state.window_ms end)
    if length(active) < state.max_requests do
      {:reply, :ok, %{state | requests: [now | active]}}
    else
      {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:enqueue_retry, item}, _from, state) do
    new_queue = :queue.in(item, state.retry_queue)
    {:reply, :ok, %{state | retry_queue: new_queue}}
  end

  def handle_call(:dequeue_retry, _from, state) do
    case :queue.out(state.retry_queue) do
      {{:value, item}, new_queue} ->
        {:reply, {:ok, item}, %{state | retry_queue: new_queue}}
      {:empty, _} ->
        {:reply, {:error, :empty}, state}
    end
  end
end

defmodule Serializer.FormatSpec do
  @moduledoc """
  Handles format specification parsing for the serialization protocol.
  Format strings define how data fields are encoded/decoded.
  """

  @type_codes %{
    "s" => :string,
    "i" => :integer,
    "f" => :float,
    "b" => :binary,
    "l" => :list,
    "m" => :map
  }

  def parse_format(format_string) when is_binary(format_string) do
    format_string
    |> String.graphemes()
    |> parse_tokens([])
  end

  defp parse_tokens([], acc), do: {:ok, Enum.reverse(acc)}
  defp parse_tokens([char | rest], acc) do
    case Map.get(@type_codes, char) do
      nil -> {:error, {:unknown_type, char}}
      type -> parse_tokens(rest, [type | acc])
    end
  end

  def validate_format(format_spec, data) when is_list(format_spec) and is_list(data) do
    if length(format_spec) == length(data) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :format_mismatch}
    end
  end
end

defmodule Serializer.Encoder do
  @moduledoc """
  Encodes data according to format specifications with retry support.
  """

  @max_retries 3
  @retry_delay_ms 100

  def encode_with_retry(format_string, data, client_id, attempt \\ 1) do
    case GenServer.call(RateLimiter, {:check_rate, client_id}) do
      :ok ->
        do_encode(format_string, data)
      {:error, :rate_limited} when attempt <= @max_retries ->
        GenServer.call(RateLimiter, {:enqueue_retry, {format_string, data, client_id}})
        Process.sleep(@retry_delay_ms * attempt)
        encode_with_retry(format_string, data, client_id, attempt + 1)
      {:error, :rate_limited} ->
        {:error, :max_retries_exceeded}
    end
  end

  defp do_encode(format_string, data) do
    with {:ok, spec} <- Serializer.FormatSpec.parse_format(format_string),
         :ok <- Serializer.FormatSpec.validate_format(spec, data) do
      encoded = encode_fields(spec, data, [])
      {:ok, build_packet(format_string, encoded)}
    end
  end

  defp encode_fields([], [], acc), do: Enum.reverse(acc)
  defp encode_fields([type | types], [value | values], acc) do
    encoded = encode_value(type, value)
    encode_fields(types, values, [encoded | acc])
  end

  defp encode_value(:string, value) when is_binary(value) do
    size = byte_size(value)
    <<size::32, value::binary>>
  end
  defp encode_value(:integer, value) when is_integer(value) do
    <<value::signed-64>>
  end
  defp encode_value(:float, value) when is_float(value) do
    <<value::float-64>>
  end
  defp encode_value(:binary, value) when is_binary(value) do
    size = byte_size(value)
    <<size::32, value::binary>>
  end
  defp encode_value(:list, value) when is_list(value) do
    serialized = :erlang.term_to_binary(value)
    size = byte_size(serialized)
    <<size::32, serialized::binary>>
  end
  defp encode_value(:map, value) when is_map(value) do
    serialized = :erlang.term_to_binary(value)
    size = byte_size(serialized)
    <<size::32, serialized::binary>>
  end
  defp encode_value(_type, value) do
    serialized = :erlang.term_to_binary(value)
    size = byte_size(serialized)
    <<size::32, serialized::binary>>
  end

  defp build_packet(format_string, encoded_fields) do
    payload = IO.iodata_to_binary(encoded_fields)
    header = :io_lib.format('~s:~w', [format_string, byte_size(payload)])
    header_bin = IO.iodata_to_binary(header)
    <<byte_size(header_bin)::16, header_bin::binary, payload::binary>>
  end
end

defmodule Serializer.Decoder do
  @moduledoc """
  Decodes packets produced by the Encoder, with format string reconstruction.
  """

  def decode_packet(<<header_len::16, header::binary-size(header_len), payload::binary>>) do
    with {:ok, {format_string, _payload_size}} <- parse_header(header),
         {:ok, spec} <- Serializer.FormatSpec.parse_format(format_string),
         {:ok, fields} <- decode_fields(spec, payload, []) do
      {:ok, %{format: format_string, fields: fields}}
    end
  end
  def decode_packet(_), do: {:error, :invalid_packet}

  defp parse_header(header_bin) do
    header_str = to_string(header_bin)
    case String.split(header_str, ":", parts: 2) do
      [format, size_str] ->
        case Integer.parse(String.trim(size_str)) do
          {size, _} -> {:ok, {format, size}}
          :error -> {:error, :invalid_header}
        end
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_header}
    end
  end

  defp decode_fields([], <<>>, acc), do: {:ok, Enum.reverse(acc)}
  defp decode_fields([], _remaining, acc), do: {:ok, Enum.reverse(acc)}
  defp decode_fields([type | types], data, acc) do
    case decode_value(type, data) do
      {:ok, value, rest} -> decode_fields(types, rest, [value | acc])
      {:error, _} = err -> err
    end
  end

  defp decode_value(:string, <<size::32, value::binary-size(size), rest::binary>>) do
    {:ok, value, rest}
  end
  defp decode_value(:integer, <<value::signed-64, rest::binary>>) do
    {:ok, value, rest}
  end
  defp decode_value(:float, <<value::float-64, rest::binary>>) do
    {:ok, value, rest}
  end
  defp decode_value(:binary, <<size::32, value::binary-size(size), rest::binary>>) do
    {:ok, value, rest}
  end
  defp decode_value(:list, <<size::32, serialized::binary-size(size), rest::binary>>) do
    {:ok, :erlang.binary_to_term(serialized), rest}
  end
  defp decode_value(:map, <<size::32, serialized::binary-size(size), rest::binary>>) do
    {:ok, :erlang.binary_to_term(serialized), rest}
  end
  defp decode_value(_, _), do: {:error, :insufficient_data}
end
